subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice agent/session selector be implemented Android-first, shared across companion apps, or deferred until a broader voice UX pass?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue asks for Android and iOS/macOS behavior and affects user-visible voice routing, so implementation scope and UX ownership need maintainer intent before automation changes companion-app flows.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Add a focused Android Voice/Talk selector using existing gateway agent/session state, keep TTS on `agents.list[].tts`, and treat iOS/macOS as follow-up work.

options.title: Shared companion-app direction
options.body: Hold implementation until maintainers define a common Talk/Voice selection model for Android, iOS, and macOS.

options.title: Defer voice routing
options.body: Leave Talk/Voice on the default session for now and close or narrow this issue only after an explicit product decision.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Add a focused Android Voice/Talk selector using existing gateway agent/session state, keep TTS on `agents.list[].tts`, and treat iOS/macOS as follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already triaged the partial TTS implementation versus remaining Talk/Voice scope in the issue discussion and authored the per-agent TTS commits.
